name: High Priestess Orlaega
description: High Priestess Orlaega is a high-ranking cleric who serves as a spiritual leader and advisor, offering practical counsel on matters of faith and craftsmanship. She advised Moriah to take a practical approach when crafting his hammer for his master's exam, guiding him toward creating a powerful shield dedicated to Moradin instead[cite: 1]. She also provided her backing when vouching for Moriah's spirit and skill before the Metal Masters' Hall[cite: 1].
ideals: Practicality: 'True devotion to the Forge-Father is found not just in grand visions, but in practical, steadfast creation[cite: 1].'
Faith: 'An artisan's work is a testament to the divine spark within[cite: 1].'
bonds: The church and spiritual institutions of Moradin[cite: 1].
Supporting and guiding dedicated dwarven craftspeople through their guild trials[cite: 1].
flaws: Can be firm and uncompromising in her spiritual and practical expectations[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Calm, authoritative, and spiritually grounded, offering wise and practical guidance[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Observes artisans with a discerning eye, offers warm approval for true craftsmanship, and speaks with the weight of clerical authority[cite: 1].
motivations: To foster true devotion and master craftsmanship among followers of the Forge-Father[cite: 1].
knowledge: Theological doctrines of Moradin, sacred smithing traditions, and guidance for guild masterwork trials[cite: 1].
gm_notes: High Priestess Orlaega serves as a divine mentor and spiritual authority for dwarven characters, particularly smiths undergoing guild trials[cite: 1]. She can be used to provide spiritual blessings, advice on masterwork crafting, or background lore regarding the church of Moradin[cite: 1].
